description: Amendment of the Sri Lanka Press Council Act, No.5 of 1973
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-09-08 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Sri Lanka Press Council Act, No. 5 of 1973 has not been updated to reflect the current social and cultural trends. Today, with the advancement of communication technology, television, Internet and social media networks have spread rapidly among the people, in addition to newspapers and radio, which has had a strong impact on public life. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Health and Mass Media to amend the Sri Lanka Press Council Act, No.5 of 1973, by including provisions on the main issues of the requirement that the correction/agreement/order decided as a result of the examination conducted by the Press Council after a newspaper report was broadcast and disseminated through an electronic media should also be broadcast and disseminated by the electronic media in which the original report was broadcast and disseminated and the registration of electronic publications of printed newspapers/magazines or electronic newspapers or magazines published in the form of printed newspapers and the examination of complaints in respect thereof, was approved by the Cabinet.
